01cellDUPLICATE002.name: Market Cave
01cellDUPLICATE002.why: the source cell has no name (Black Marsh.esm 01cellDUPLICATE002) and no household or promise of ours is kept in it; what a player finds inside is three market stalls, an armour rack, a weapon rack and food stores in a cave, so it is named for that (AGENT_INVENTED)

XeechLeelCouncilHouse.name: The Council House of the Xeech-Leel
XeechLeelCouncilHouse.why: the thieves' line names the house by its door (thieves.md:350); no household lives there and no promise of the place record names it (AGENT_INVENTED)

XeechLeelWardensQuarters.name: Council Wardens' Quarters
XeechLeelWardensQuarters.why: the thieves' line puts the council's six wardens in Dragonthorn Manor's barracks behind the council house (thieves.md:213, :350); no household lives there (AGENT_INVENTED)

XeechLeelStrongroom.name: Council Strongroom
XeechLeelStrongroom.why: the thieves' line names the council's strongroom behind an iron door (thieves.md:210-236, :350); no household lives there (AGENT_INVENTED)

MarketSmithy.name: The Market Smithy
MarketSmithy.why: the place record's the market smithy (gives and source note), a room of ours behind an added door (AGENT_INVENTED)

LevyPost.name: The Levy's Post
LevyPost.why: the place record's the levy's post (gives and source note), a room of ours behind an added door (AGENT_INVENTED)

HelstromXanmeer.name: Helstrom Xanmeer
HelstromXanmeer.why: the place record names it the old Xanmeer at the city's heart; the room is its hall, where the council of the Xeech-Leel holds its open sittings and the Root Talk meets (AGENT_INVENTED)

add.name: Sealed Spring
add.why: the city tree's spring, shut away (main story, The Sour Spring): a lidded clay urn (Dragonborn's Dunmer urn, nothing Nordic) at the foot of the sacred tree, 1150 units east of its trunk, past the great tree's roots and its sap, named so a player reads what it is; locked and owned by the town in the stock source

a locked chest the main story can use in place of a back room, in the one-room house nearest the city landing (Ixtul-Bei's household): King of the Murkmire's rustic chest beside the household's dresser (Black Marsh.esm:1E4354), against the same wall and turned as it is, at the floor's height there (the dresser's base 14771 plus the chest's 19 below its middle); owned by the household and locked at Novice in the stock source

add.name: Urn Case
add.why: the case that holds the order's sealed urn (Sisei-Xul, quests 5 to 10 and the ending; House Cardruhn, 9. The Urn): King of the Murkmire's rustic chest beside the hall's arcane enchanter inside the door, named so a player reads what it is; owned by the town and locked at Expert in the stock source; the urn itself is the quests' own thing put inside it

the rootworm's root pool: the city tree's own pool of Hist sap at its roots (main story, 5. The Handler, 6. The Glass Eye, every ride; the Underground Express of the canon, whose riders board at a root pool); King of the Murkmire's WaterPuddleHist sized to the great tree, standing as the tree's sap pool (the sap stage keeps a hand-placed pool on the trunk)

the mouth of the rootworm's tunnel at the root pool's west lip, where the worm comes up among the roots: King of the Murkmire's own rootworm tunnel entrance (RootWormTunnelsEnt01MarshMud02), sunk 20 units into the mud
the map marker of the rootworm's landing under the city tree (MN06's marker.mn06.rootworm-helstrom), on the root pool's east lip between the pool and the root-tender's spot

the council house of the Xeech-Leel (thieves, 9. The Council's Strongroom, 10. Two of Four, 12. The Great Heist): the house Dragonthorn Manor stands in at King of the Murkmire's Lilmoth (MurkmireHouse06Beige), on flat dry ground in the town south-east of the sacred tree, its front door opening east onto the street

drop.King of the Murkmire.esp:864C11: Lilmoth's strong box of levelled gems and jewellery: nothing levelled is placed (decision 0035); the council's gold is the strongroom's, placed by its quest

the boardwalk off the council house's porch, laid where Lilmoth lays it at Dragonthorn Manor (MurkmireWalkwayShort01), so one walks from the porch onto the town's ground

the wardens' quarters behind the council house, set back from it as Lilmoth sets Dragonthorn Manor's barracks behind the manor, with room for the back door between (MurkmireHouse07Red), seated on the town's ground
the wardens' quarters' door, where Lilmoth sets the barracks' ground door, into a copy of Dragonthorn Manor Barracks (its beds for the council's wardens)
the council house's back door, inside: a Murkmire door (MudHutLDoor02, the house's own) in the hall's back wall on the ground floor, at the floor's height (the shell's 5648)
the council house's back door, outside, in the house's back wall towards the wardens' quarters, locked at Expert (thieves.md:350)

add.name: Chest

the old Xanmeer, the record's one stone building: Black Marsh & Valenwood's own stepped temple (01aztectemple2, 1mjyaztecbuilding3redone; 69.8 x 65.4 x 32.1 m at scale 1) on the footprint of the source's hidden ziggurat; at 0.78 it is 54 x 51 m and 25 m tall, the biggest thing in the city by twice but no wider than the camp and houses round it, where 0.95 (66 m) swallowed them; its broad stair is on its local south face, turned (315 degrees) to the south-east where the city's way (path.13) comes up from the market; its underside sunk 60 to 160 units into the ground so no edge shows a gap; its own collision is its mesh's, so what is walked is what is seen

the levy's post's door (MudHutLDoor02), into a copy of King of the Murkmire's Lilmoth Guardhouse
